name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
label: historical_strata_v6_139_control
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  suffices ∀ S, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars post ⊆ S → h1 ∈ S →
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars
        (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post) ⊆ S by
    exact this _ (List.subset_append_left _ _) (by simp)
  induction post
  all_goals simp only [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case const | op | bvar | fvar => exact fun _ hs _ => hs
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case app ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro S hs hh
    split
    · split
      · simpa [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] using hh
      · exact hs
    · exact List.append_subset.mpr
        ⟨ih₁ S (List.append_subset.mp hs).1 hh,
          ih₂ S (List.append_subset.mp hs).2 hh⟩
  all_goals (intro S hs hh; simp only [List.append_subset] at hs ⊢; grind only [List.Subset])
